criteria.long_description: The 10–15 minute episode demonstrates usable rules and at least one consequential player choice whose outcome changes play.

ratings.description: Strong: play is coherent and consequential agency is clearly evidenced
Partial: a session is shown but rules, agency, or consequences are incomplete or unclear
Not demonstrated: no assessable playable session or consequential choice

criteria.long_description: The episode and records demonstrate facilitation that supports participant agency, actionable safety procedures, informed recording/submission consent, and privacy-conscious documentation.

ratings.description: Strong: facilitation, safety, consent, and privacy are all evidenced
Partial: procedures are present with a material gap or weak evidence
Not demonstrated: required consent/safety evidence is absent or serious concerns are present

criteria.description: Episode construction, listener orientation, and intelligibility
criteria.long_description: Editing, structure, speaker identification, sound or image clarity, and transcript/captions allow a person who did not attend to follow participants, rules, choices, and scene changes.

ratings.description: Strong: episode and access text are consistently clear and listener-oriented
Partial: the episode remains usable but recurring clarity, structure, or transcript/caption problems interfere
Not demonstrated: the episode or access text is missing or substantially unintelligible

criteria.description: Session materials, access, permissions, and credits
criteria.long_description: The package contains usable final rules and applicable session materials, identifies access provisions, documents permissions without unnecessary private data, and credits/licences third-party work.

ratings.description: Strong: package is complete, accessible, privacy-conscious, and fully credited
Partial: materials are usable with a limited access, permission, or credit gap
Not demonstrated: core materials are absent or serious access/permission/credit problems remain

criteria.long_description: The record identifies a test question, date, participants or roles, observed evidence, problems, and at least one resulting revision or evidence-based retention decision.

ratings.description: Strong: evidence and before/after reasoning support concrete design decisions
Partial: testing occurred but evidence, revision, or rationale is thin
Not demonstrated: no assessable test-and-revision record

criteria.description: Individual contribution, analysis, and AI appendix
criteria.long_description: Each student identifies concrete contributions and analyzes one effect on the project. Complete relevant AI chatlogs or a no-AI statement are included without credentials or private participant information.

ratings.description: Strong: every contribution entry is specific and analytical, and the appendix is complete
Partial: entries or analysis are uneven, or the appendix has a limited omission
Not demonstrated: contribution evidence/analysis or the required appendix is absent
